name: Ash
tagline: AI built specifically for therapy and mental-health support.
description: Ash is a mental-health support app built on a purpose-built psychology foundation model rather than a general-purpose chatbot. It draws on therapeutic approaches like CBT, DBT, ACT and motivational interviewing to help users work through thoughts and patterns, and is designed to challenge rather than simply validate. Free on iOS and Android; positioned as support, not a replacement for a licensed therapist.
insight: Maker Slingshot AI raised $93M (a16z-backed) and launched Ash publicly in July 2025.

modelSupport.notes: Built on Slingshot's purpose-built foundation model for psychology.

edge: Unlike general chatbots tuned to agree with you, Ash is trained only for therapy on a psychology-specific model and is built to push back, not just validate.
pros: Draws on CBT, DBT, ACT methods
Built by a dedicated mental-health research lab
cons: Not a replacement for a licensed therapist
Free now; a paid tier is expected later

references.title: Slingshot AI, the a16z-backed startup, launches a therapy chatbot
